info.title: BOS Core — Phase A V5 contract
info.description: Frozen Phase A surface. Covers /ser/compute /sfi/check /relay/simulate /mc/propagate /twin/run plus D1 sunset legacy twin compute endpoints.

post.summary: Phase A — generic Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation (Eq.7)
post.description:
Run the V5 MC propagation.

Paper map: Eq.7 (sample-and-evaluate Monte Carlo). For
``target_func="ser"`` the SER engine is the per-sample evaluator
(evidence_level=supported). For other targets the engine returns
a deterministic placeholder so the full request/response contract
can be exercised (evidence_level=planned).

post.summary: Phase A — three-stage M1→M2→M3 relay simulation
post.description:
Run the V5 relay simulation.

Paper map: M1 (deconstruction) → M2 (assimilation, signal decay per
Eq.6) → M3 (stabilization). Each stage emits a BoundaryLedger via
mass_balance.reconcile, so closure_pct < 95% produces a warning.

post.summary: Phase A — paper-strict, stateless SER compute
post.description:
Compute SER deterministically; optionally propagate MC uncertainty.

Paper map: Eq. 1–3 (deterministic SER), Eq. 7 (Monte Carlo uncertainty).

This handler is **stateless** — no Calculation row is written. For the
persisted V9 behavior, use ``POST /api/v1/ser/compute_legacy``.

post.summary: Phase A — paper-strict SFI envelope check (Eq.5-6)
post.description:
Run the V5 SFI check.

Paper map: Eq.5 (per-axis envelope), Eq.6 (physical horizon
tau_max = ln(s0/s_min)/k_decay).
Honest k_decay treatment: provenance drives evidence_level.

Run the digital twin forward over an explicit input schedule.

No DB persistence, no twin record required. If ``observations`` is
provided and ``enable_ekf=True``, each predict step is followed by
an EKF update. Innovation statistics are aggregated across the run.
DEPRECATED (Phase A V5 D1 sunset): use POST /api/v1/twin/run for stateless predictions. Old stateful path stays callable until 2027-05-17 (T0 + 12 months from Phase A start).
DEPRECATED (Phase A V5 D1 sunset): use POST /api/v1/twin/run for stateless trajectory simulation. Old stateful path stays callable until 2027-05-17.
DEPRECATED (Phase A V5 D1 sunset): use POST /api/v1/twin/run with an observations array for stateless EKF correction. Old stateful path stays callable until 2027-05-17.

margin_to_breach.title: Margin To Breach
margin_to_breach.description: Absolute distance to the nearest envelope breach in axis units. Negative means already over the boundary.

AxisStatus.title: AxisStatus
AxisStatus.description: Per-axis verdict returned to the caller.

mass_residual_kg.title: Mass Residual Kg
mass_residual_kg.description: Closure residual [kg]. Should be near zero. Negative means more out than in (likely measurement/sim error).

closure_pct.title: Closure Pct
closure_pct.description: Mass closure percentage from mass_balance.reconcile. Ideal = 100. Below 95 raises a poor_boundary_closure warning.

BoundaryLedger.title: BoundaryLedger
BoundaryLedger.description: Mass/N closure ledger for a single relay stage.

tolerance.title: Tolerance
tolerance.description: Fractional tolerance band around each setpoint.

ControlProfile.title: ControlProfile
ControlProfile.description: Optional setpoint-driven control profile applied across all stages.

DistSpec.title: DistSpec
DistSpec.description:
Per-field uncertainty distribution spec for Monte Carlo propagation.

The engine maps these to ``app.engine.core.monte_carlo_engine.MCInput``.
For Phase A the supported distributions are the same set the engine
already implements.

earliest_breach_hour.title: Earliest Breach Hour
earliest_breach_hour.description: Hours from t0 until the predicted breach.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence the breach occurs within horizon.

n_updates.title: N Updates
n_updates.description: Count of EKF update steps applied.

mean_abs_innovation.title: Mean Abs Innovation
mean_abs_innovation.description: Mean absolute innovation per observed channel (weight / temperature / moisture).

InnovationStats.title: InnovationStats
InnovationStats.description: Aggregate EKF innovation diagnostics across the run.

low.title: Low
low.description: Lower bound of the uncertainty band [1/h].

high.title: High
high.description: Upper bound of the uncertainty band [1/h].

source.title: Source
source.description: Provenance of the value. Drives evidence_level downgrade: 'measured' -> validated, 'fitted' -> supported, 'literature' -> planned.

citation.title: Citation
citation.description: Optional reference (DOI, paper ID, internal dataset).

KDecayBand.title: KDecayBand
KDecayBand.description:
Uncertainty band for the first-order decay constant k_decay.

Honest: callers MUST declare ``source`` so the API can downgrade
``evidence_level`` when the value is literature-prior rather than
measured (paper §SFI honesty rule).

convergence_check.title: Convergence Check
convergence_check.description: Engine-defined cheap convergence proxy (e.g. CI width vs /sqrt(n) decay). False does not imply non-convergence, only that the proxy was not run.

McDiagnostics.title: McDiagnostics
McDiagnostics.description: Estimator diagnostics for the propagation run.

mean.title: Mean
mean.description: Distribution centre. Interpretation per family: normal/lognormal/triangular → mean; uniform → centre of band.

std.title: Std
std.description: Standard deviation (≥ 0). Zero collapses to a constant.

units.title: Units
units.description: Optional axis units for downstream provenance.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Per-variable distribution spec; keys are the target function's input variable names.

target_func.title: Target Func
target_func.description: Which downstream BOS compute to propagate through.

target_func_config.title: Target Func Config
target_func_config.description: Target-specific config — schema is per-target and validated by the engine. This is the single Phase A loose-typed escape hatch.

n_samples.title: N Samples
n_samples.description: MC sample count. Eq.7 estimator variance scales 1/√N.

return_samples.title: Return Samples
return_samples.description: If True, response includes raw sample array (can be large).

compute_sobol.title: Compute Sobol
compute_sobol.description: If True, compute first-order + total Sobol indices.

McPropagateRequest.title: McPropagateRequest
McPropagateRequest.description: Phase A Monte Carlo propagation input — paper-strict per §2.4.

samples.title: Samples
samples.description: Raw sample array; returned only when return_samples=True.

McPropagateResponse.title: McPropagateResponse
McPropagateResponse.description: Phase A Monte Carlo propagation response — paper-strict.

ess.title: Ess
ess.description: Effective sample size (None when not computed).

McSummary.title: McSummary
McSummary.description: Diagnostics returned when monte_carlo was requested.

n_samples.title: N Samples
n_samples.description: Number of MC samples. Eq.7 estimator variance scales 1/sqrt(N).

distributions.title: Distributions
distributions.description: Per-field uncertainty spec. Keys must be SerComputeRequest field names (dm_in, dm_out, n_in, n_rec).

MonteCarloConfig.title: MonteCarloConfig
MonteCarloConfig.description: MC propagation config; omit on the request to get deterministic only.

k_decay_band.description: Uncertainty band for k_decay (Eq.6). Reused from SFI schema — see app.schemas.sfi.KDecayBand.

tau_max_h.title: Tau Max H
tau_max_h.description: Eq.6 physical horizon tau_max = ln(s0/s_min)/k_decay [hours]. Computed by the engine when omitted; passed-through when caller pre-computes.

stage_completion.title: Stage Completion
stage_completion.description: Per-stage completion fraction in [0, 1]. 1.0 means the stage ran to its scheduled end without abort. Partial values mean an internal stop (e.g. k_decay violation).

sfi_check_passed_at_each_stage.title: Sfi Check Passed At Each Stage

k_decay_violation_at_step.title: K Decay Violation At Step
k_decay_violation_at_step.description: First step index where Eq.6 horizon was exceeded, or None.

RelayHealth.title: RelayHealth
RelayHealth.description: Aggregate health verdict for the whole relay simulation.

initial_state.description: Initial biomass / substrate / T / M / N / signal state.

horizon_steps.title: Horizon Steps
horizon_steps.description: Number of dt-sized steps to simulate.

RelaySimulateRequest.title: RelaySimulateRequest
RelaySimulateRequest.description: Phase A relay simulation input — paper-strict per §2.3.

boundary_ledger.title: Boundary Ledger
boundary_ledger.description: Exactly three entries: M1, M2, M3.

final_ser_ci.title: Final Ser Ci
final_ser_ci.description: MC 95% CI on final_ser if monte_carlo was requested.

RelaySimulateResponse.title: RelaySimulateResponse
RelaySimulateResponse.description: Phase A relay simulation response — paper-strict.

dm_out.title: Dm Out
dm_out.description: Recovered dry matter [kg]. Must be <= dm_in (validator).

d_prime.title: D Prime
d_prime.description: Normalized deconstruction rate D' in [0,1] (paper Eq.3).

g_prime.title: G Prime
g_prime.description: Normalized growth rate G' in [0,1] (paper Eq.3).

SerComputeRequest.title: SerComputeRequest
SerComputeRequest.description: Phase A SER compute input — paper-strict per §2.1 of PHASE_A_PLAN.

ser_ci_lower.title: Ser Ci Lower
ser_ci_lower.description: MC lower 95% CI bound; None if MC not run.

ser_ci_upper.title: Ser Ci Upper
ser_ci_upper.description: MC upper 95% CI bound; None if MC not run.

delta_ser.title: Delta Ser
delta_ser.description: SER delta vs baseline; positive = improvement.

evidence_level.title: Evidence Level
evidence_level.description: Evidence tier for the result (per BOS evidence policy).

SerComputeResponse.title: SerComputeResponse
SerComputeResponse.description: Phase A SER compute response — paper-strict.

target_state.title: Target State
target_state.description: Per-axis target values. Keys must match SfiMeasurements fields (e.g. temperature_c, moisture_pct, ph).

tolerance_pct.title: Tolerance Pct
tolerance_pct.description: Tolerance as % of axis range; bracketed forecast band.

SetpointProfile.title: SetpointProfile
SetpointProfile.description: Desired operating envelope for the forecast-breach check.

k_decay_band.description: Uncertainty band for k_decay (Eq.6 input). Required to enable the physical-horizon check.

s0.title: S0
s0.description: Initial substrate pool [kg]. Combined with s_min + k_decay to evaluate Eq.6 tau_max = ln(s0/s_min)/k_decay.

monte_carlo.description: Optional MC propagation on the composite score.

SfiCheckRequest.title: SfiCheckRequest
SfiCheckRequest.description: Phase A SFI check input — paper-strict per §2.2.

forecast_breach.description: Earliest predicted envelope breach within horizon.

k_decay_used.description: Echo of the k_decay_band actually used (for audit).

SfiCheckResponse.title: SfiCheckResponse
SfiCheckResponse.description: Phase A SFI check response — paper-strict.

feed_rate_g_per_larva_day.title: Feed Rate G Per Larva Day

SfiMeasurements.title: SfiMeasurements
SfiMeasurements.description: Current sensor snapshot. Each axis bounded by physical limits.

TwinInputStep.title: TwinInputStep
TwinInputStep.description:
Per-step control vector. Matches digital_twin_engine.predict_step
inputs dict (feed_rate / ventilation / heating).

TwinObservation.title: TwinObservation
TwinObservation.description: Per-step sensor observation for the EKF update path.

config.description: Kinetic parameters; defaults match the V9 baseline.

observations.title: Observations
observations.description: Optional per-step observations for EKF correction. When provided, MUST have the same length as ``inputs``.

enable_ekf.title: Enable Ekf
enable_ekf.description: If True and observations present, run EKF update after each predict step. Ignored when observations is None.

TwinRunRequest.title: TwinRunRequest
TwinRunRequest.description:
Phase A stateless digital-twin run — V5 strict.

No DB persistence, no batch/twin record required. Initial state
is supplied in the body and the engine produces a trajectory.

estimated_states.title: Estimated States
estimated_states.description: Post-EKF estimates (= predicted states when EKF off).

TwinRunResponse.title: TwinRunResponse
TwinRunResponse.description: Phase A stateless digital-twin response — V5 strict.

Warning.title: Warning
Warning.description: Operator-visible warning recorded during the simulation.

app__schemas__relay__TwinSnapshot.title: TwinSnapshot
app__schemas__relay__TwinSnapshot.description: Single time-step snapshot in the relay trajectory.

signal_activity_au.title: Signal Activity Au
signal_activity_au.description: Signal-molecule activity [arbitrary units; paper BU/mL]. Tracked through M2 to evaluate Eq.6 decay.

app__schemas__relay__TwinState.title: TwinState
app__schemas__relay__TwinState.description: Initial / final state of the digital twin.

app__schemas__twin__TwinState.title: TwinState
app__schemas__twin__TwinState.description: Twin state at a single instant. Used as initial + final state.
